title: Silence CS0115 by changing 'override' to 'new'
problemSignature: CS0115: no suitable method found to override
rootCauseHypothesis: The Core base member signature changed; the override no longer matches.
proposedActions: REJECTED APPROACH: replacing 'override' with 'new' to make the compiler stop complaining.
knownCounterexamples: Changing override to new hides the base member and silently breaks polymorphic dispatch; the client method is no longer invoked by Core. The correct fix is to align the override signature with the new base signature from the decompiled DLL.

reviewHistory.reason: Breaks runtime polymorphism; masks the real signature change.

rejectionReason: Masks a real base-signature change and breaks polymorphic dispatch at runtime.
